capabilities: Look up word definitions on selection or Ctrl-hover
Fetch definitions from the Wiktionary REST API grouped by language
Filter results with a language allow-list
Configure hover delay, modifier key, examples, and sense count
Follow links in the popup back to the Wiktionary page
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Definitions are © Wiktionary contributors under CC BY-SA. Requires an internet connection; hover lookup is desktop-only and pop-out windows are not covered yet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a word's definition without leaving the editor or opening a browser.

relations.evidence: For each lookup the plugin calls the Wiktionary REST API

summary: Dictionary plugin that shows a word's Wiktionary definition in a popup when you select it or Ctrl-hover it, across many languages.
